Trump Faces Midterm Elections Amid Legal Challenges and Farmer Aid

Ahead of the US midterm elections, the Trump administration pledged $15 billion to US farmers in the weeks leading up to the vote. Simultaneously, Donald Trump faced a significant legal setback concerning an "Epstein birthday book." Reports also highlighted concerns about the potential impact of Trump's noncitizen voter lists on the midterms, with some coverage questioning whether top Trump officials were permitted to campaign. Additionally, a poll indicated a fraying coalition among Trump voters, while Kamala Harris urged high turnout and criticized President Trump. The broader implications for India were also noted, with questions raised about the potential impact on India if Trump's power were weakened.
